notAuthority.title: Kafa'a is not an authority

print.intro: A one-page passport in the language you are reading. It carries no email, no photo and no task detail.
print.title: Kafa'a Skills Passport

wallet.intro: Wrap your Kafa'a course certificates and completions in signed, shareable badges (Open Badges 3.0 format).
wallet.notice: Internal Kafa'a credential; not a FANR certificate or licence. Licences and qualification records are never issued as badges.
wallet.noneBody: Issue a badge from one of your certificates or course completions below.
wallet.noSources: No Kafa'a certificate or course completion is recorded for you yet.
wallet.issueConsequence: Kafa'a signs an Open Badges 3.0 credential with its issuer key and records the action in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger. Anyone with the share link sees your initials, the course and the skills it evidences.
wallet.neverMirrors: FANR licences and qualification mirrors are never issued as badges. Security-related training shows as qualified or not qualified only.
wallet.how1: Each badge is an Open Badges 3.0-shaped credential: the course, its criteria, the Kafa'a skills it aligns to and the evidence.
wallet.how2: It is signed with an Ed25519 key. Changing any field of the downloaded file makes the signature invalid.
wallet.how3: The share link shows your initials only. A badge expires with its certificate and can be withdrawn at any time.

badge.withdrawConsequence: The verify page will show the badge as revoked from now on, and the skill evidence it added is removed from your passport. The action is audited.

sig.validOffline: Signed with the offline demo key

verify.intro: Check a Kafa'a badge: its signature, its current status and what it certifies. Only the holder's initials are shown.
verify.bannerTitle: Not a FANR certificate or licence
verify.notFoundBody: No Kafa'a badge has this link. Check the address with the holder.
verify.invalidBody: This file was changed after it was issued, or it was not issued by Kafa'a. Do not rely on it.

statusBody.expired: The signature is genuine, but the badge or its certificate is past its validity date.
statusBody.revoked: The signature is genuine, but the badge or its certificate has been revoked.
statusBody.renewal_due: This micro-credential is still valid but is due for renewal, or one of its parts has lapsed.
statusBody.superseded: The holder renewed this micro-credential; the newer credential replaces this one.
statusBody.pending_approval: This micro-credential has been requested and is waiting for a training manager.

verify.pasteHint: The file the holder downloaded from their Kafa'a wallet.
verify.unknownBody: The signature checks out, but this badge is not in the registry of this Kafa'a tenant.
verify.privacy: The file is checked in your browser and is not uploaded. To check a certificate number instead:
verify.keysNote: Signatures are checked against the issuer keys Kafa'a publishes.

stat.levelsSub: Validated or adjusted by a manager

ci.empty: A check-in turns a self-rated skill into a validated one.
ci.withdrawBody: Your raters will no longer see it. Answers already given stay on record.
ci.privacy: Peers see only the skills you name for them. They never see your self levels, your other skills or other raters' answers. HR sees no individual ratings.
ci.qualOnlyTitle: {n} skills are verified by qualification only
ci.securityNote: Security competencies show as qualified or not qualified only, so they are not listed.
ci.rateEmpty: Choose at least one skill on the left.
ci.noteHint: What did you do that shows this level? 3 to 300 characters.
ci.peersFamily: You have no team on record, so colleagues from your job family are listed.
ci.peerPrivacy: Only the skill names you choose for them, with your note to raters.
ci.confirmBody: {n} skill(s) go to {manager} for validation, and {peers} peer(s) are asked for a rating.
ci.sent: Check-in sent to your line manager
ci.noManager: Kafa'a cannot find your line manager. Ask HR to record it, then try again.

ci.rateConfirmBody: Your colleague and their manager will see these ratings. You can change them while the check-in is open.

val.empty: Check-ins from your team appear here.
val.qualOnly: This skill is verified by qualification records only. A check-in cannot change it.
val.confirmBody: Validated and adjusted levels become validated evidence on the person's passport. The decision is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.

cal.ratersEyebrow: Mean rating minus the independent evidence level; flagged at ±{flag} over {n}+ ratings
cal.noRaters: No ratings can be compared with independent evidence yet.

mc.intro: Short, stackable credentials earned from evidence already in Kafa'a: courses, assessments, opportunities and validated skills. Each one is signed, shareable and checked again whenever you open this page.
mc.notice: Kafa'a micro-credentials recognise learning and practice. They are not FANR licences, operator certifications or qualifications, and they never change a qualification or licence record.

crit.lapsed: Completed on {date}, now outside the validity window
crit.manualNote: Checked by a training manager when you request it
crit.missing_skill: Skill not at the level yet
crit.skill_claimed: Level {level} is self-assessed: needs evidence or a validation
crit.missing_adaptive: Adaptive check not at the level yet

act.claimBody: Kafa'a checks the listed evidence again and, if every criterion is met, issues a signed micro-credential to your wallet.
act.requestBody: The automatic criteria are checked now; a training manager then confirms the manual criteria before the micro-credential is issued.
act.renewBody: Your evidence is checked again and a new credential replaces the current one, with a new validity period.

mc.stacksBody: A stacked credential is issued only when every part is held and valid. If a part expires, the stack is flagged for renewal.
mc.stackComponentDue: A part of this stack has lapsed: renew the part to keep the stack current.
mc.catalogueBody: Every published micro-credential, what it asks for and what it unlocks. Your progress is worked out from the evidence listed.

mc.mineBody: Everything you have claimed, requested or renewed, including earlier versions.
mc.mineEmptyBody: Pick one from the catalogue: the ones marked Ready to claim can be issued straight away.
mc.withdrawBody: It stops verifying for anyone you shared it with. The evidence it was built from stays on your profile.
mc.noEligibility: Eligibility could not be checked just now. Try again in a moment.

admin.title: Micro-credential definitions
admin.notice: Definitions must not use licence, certification or qualification wording: micro-credentials recognise development only and never stand in for FANR or ENEC qualification decisions.
admin.suppressedNote: Counts below 10 are not shown to protect privacy.
admin.approvalsTmOnly: Only a training manager can approve manual criteria.
admin.ownRequest: Your own request: another training manager decides.
admin.approveBody: You confirm the manual criteria are met. The micro-credential is signed and issued to the holder.
admin.declineBody: The person is told the request was declined, with your note.
admin.publishBody: The new version becomes the one people earn. Earlier versions stay valid for those who hold them.
admin.retireBody: Nobody can earn it any more. Credentials already issued stay valid until they expire.
admin.codeHint: MC- followed by capitals, digits or hyphens.
admin.stackHelp: A stack has no criteria of its own: it is issued when every published part is held and valid.
admin.manualHelp: A manual criterion is confirmed by a training manager when the person requests the micro-credential.
admin.wordingBody: Remove licence, certification, qualification or regulator wording: micro-credentials must not imply a FANR certification.

dk.intro: Kafa'a shows how sure it is about each skill, not just a level. Every source counts once, newer and stronger evidence weighs more, and evidence ages at the pace of its skill: digital skills faster, plant science slower.
dk.toConfidence: How sure are we about this skill?
dk.emptyBody: Once a course, qualification, check-in or work sign-off is recorded, your skills appear here with how sure we are about each.
dk.notAuthority: Confidence bands describe how much evidence Kafa'a holds. They are not a qualification, a licence decision or an assessment of competence; qualification and licence entries mirror the licensee's systems.

band.hint: How sure we are: the band comes from the cautious end of an 80% range around the confidence.

stat.mediumSub: good evidence, one more source would firm it up
stat.droppingSub: will drop a band or a level if nothing new is recorded
stat.ageingSub: strongest evidence is older than its half-life

bandsExplained.title: What the bands mean
bandsExplained.high: Even the cautious end of the range is 60% or more: several independent, recent sources agree.
bandsExplained.medium: The cautious end is 30% to 60%: solid evidence, but from one source or getting older.
bandsExplained.low: The cautious end is under 30%: mostly self-rated, or the evidence has aged.
bandsExplained.note: A low band is not a judgement on you. It says Kafa'a holds little recent evidence, and the actions under each skill show how to add some.

list.title: Skill by skill
list.intro: The band, the range and the sources behind each skill; open a skill to see its full record and how it will age.
list.security: {n} security skills are shown as qualified or not qualified on the passport only.

record.none: No evidence recorded for this skill yet.
record.weightHint: Weight of the best row from this source: basis (verified 1.0, evidenced 0.8, validated 0.6, self-rated 0.3) times how much it has decayed.
record.peerNote: Peer ratings inform your manager's validation; they are not counted on their own.

drawer.projectionIntro: Confidence over the next 36 months, re-calculated with this skill's half-life of {months} months. Current qualifications are assumed to stay current.
drawer.stable: Stays in the same band for the next 6 months.
drawer.raiseNone: Nothing to add: the evidence is strong and recent.

raise.validate: Ask your manager to validate it

raise.refreshBody: A recent course resets the clock on ageing evidence.
raise.work: Use it on a stretch assignment
raise.workBody: A gig, rotation or on-the-job sign-off adds work evidence, a source nothing else replaces.
raise.credentialBody: A micro-credential aligned to this skill adds a signed credential as a further source.
raise.requalBody: This skill is verified by a qualification record: it stays verified while the qualification is current.

why.validate_self: Only you have rated this skill so far; a manager's validation is a second, independent source.
why.validate_none: No source has confirmed this skill yet.
why.refresh_ageing: Your strongest evidence is older than the half-life, so it counts one level lower; {course} would refresh it.
why.refresh_drop: Confidence will drop a band on {date}; {course} would refresh it before then.
why.work: No work evidence yet: using the skill on the job is a source of its own.
why.credential: {code} is aligned to this skill and you do not hold it yet.
why.requal: {code} is evidenced by a qualification standard; requalification keeps it verified.
why.ready_sure: Counting only skills we are fairly sure of (medium or high band): {pct}%.
why.ready_unsure: {n} of the skills behind this readiness rest on low-band evidence.
why.ready_band_high: The skills that carry this readiness are well evidenced.
why.ready_band_medium: The skills that carry this readiness are reasonably evidenced.
why.ready_band_low: The skills that carry this readiness rest mostly on self-ratings or old evidence.
why.preview: {n} skill states would change band with these half-lives (cells naming fewer than 10 people are suppressed).
why.validate_add: A manager's validation would add an independent source to what is already recorded.

reason.qual_ageing: Verified by a current qualification record (level {level}, {date})
reason.qual_lapsed_ageing: Lapsed qualification record (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.course_ageing: Course passed (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.assessment_ageing: Assessment passed (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.jpm_ageing: Job performance measure passed (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.rating_claimed_ageing: Self-rated, not yet validated (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.rating_validated_ageing: Validated by a manager (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.ojt_ageing: On-the-job work signed off (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower
reason.credential_ageing: Credential held (level {level}, {date}) · older than its {months}-month half-life, counted one level lower

ready.label: Sure of
ready.rangeHint: Readiness counting only the skills we are fairly sure of, up to readiness counting every skill.
ready.allSure: Every skill behind this readiness is in the medium or high band.

method.title: The way confidence is calculated changed
method.fs03: From {date}, confidence blends independent sources and ages by skill class (fast, standard, slow). Numbers from before that date are not comparable with today's.
method.half_lives: The half-lives were changed on {date}. Confidence before and after that date is not comparable.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Three decay classes, a published blend and an honest range. The same rule runs on the server and in this page.

classes.none: The decay classes are not available.

methodCard.title: How the number is made
methodCard.weightsValue: Verified {v} · evidenced {e} · validated {a} · self-rated {c}, times how much the row has decayed
methodCard.sourcesValue: Qualification, training, assessment, work, credential, manager or expert validation and self-rating: the best row of each source counts once
methodCard.diminishValue: Sources combine strongest first; each extra source counts half as much as the one before it
methodCard.intervalValue: A {pct} Wilson range around the confidence: few or old sources give a wide range
methodCard.bandsValue: High when the cautious end is {high} or more, medium from {medium}, low below
methodCard.ageingValue: Evidence older than its class half-life counts one level lower; a current qualification does not age

bench.title: Benchmarks
bench.WEF-FOJ: skills change at different speeds, so evidence ages by skill class instead of one clock for everything.
bench.SKILLS-TECH: a multi-source record per skill (self, peer, manager, assessment, work), each with its date and provenance.
bench.FORECAST: a range instead of a point estimate, and a banner when the method changes.

admin.intro: Half-lives per decay class, how confident the skill records across the workforce are, and a what-if preview before you change anything. Aggregates only; cells naming fewer than 10 people are suppressed.
admin.ageingSub: strongest evidence older than its half-life
admin.curvesEyebrow: Weight left after months, by decay class
admin.curvesNote: A current qualification does not age; everything else halves its weight every half-life.
admin.rationaleHint: 10 to 500 characters; shown in the engine change log.
admin.confirmBody: Fast {fast}, standard {standard}, slow {slow} months. The change is logged, the engine cards are versioned, the NEXUS ledger records it, and every person's skill states are recomputed.
admin.saved: Half-lives saved and every skill state recomputed
admin.onlyAdmins: Only a platform admin can change the half-lives; you can preview the impact.
admin.previewEyebrow: What would change today (nothing is saved)
admin.pNone: No skill state would change band.
admin.distIntro: Active skill states by band. Cells naming fewer than 10 people are suppressed.
admin.backfillEyebrow: W5 open item, closed by FS03
admin.backfillBody: {with} of {all} issued micro-credential awards carry their skills evidence ({rows} evidence rows), so a credential counts as a source.
admin.recomputeBody: Rebuilds every person's skill states from their evidence with the current half-lives. Audited; nothing is removed.
admin.lastTitle: Last change to the skills engine
admin.toLog: Full change log and engine cards
admin.howIntro: The three classes, the published blend and the benchmarks behind them.

adm.tierBodyOwner: Move a credential into or out of the tier. The reason is recorded in the ledger.
adm.addBody: Its holders become eligible for the gigs and rotations that name it.
adm.removeBody: It stops unlocking placements; holders keep the credential.
adm.unlocksTitle: Placements that name a strategic credential
adm.unlocksBody: Gigs (F08) and rotations (F15). Security placements cannot be gated this way.
adm.unlocksEmpty: No placement names a credential yet
adm.offBody: The placement no longer asks for the credential.
adm.onBody: The placement asks for the credential again.
adm.addUnlock: Name a credential on a placement
adm.saveTitle: Name this credential on the placement?
adm.saveBody: {code} will be asked for on {target}; holders are eligible.

lr.intro: Your credentials, qualification status and skills in one record shaped like the 1EdTech Comprehensive Learner Record. Share only what you choose, for as long as you choose.
lr.neverBody: Security standards and skills, medical and fitness-for-duty detail, and your name. A shared record shows your initials only.
lr.forbiddenBody: Learner records are for staff with a skills passport.
lr.recordBody: Everything that can be shared, by kind.

kindEmpty.skill: No skills at level 1 or above yet.

lr.emptyBody: Credentials, qualification lines and skills appear here as you earn them.

problem.invalid: Choose 1 to 30 items, a label of 3 to 80 characters and an expiry within 90 days
problem.not_shareable: One of the items can no longer be shared

wizard.title: Share part of my record
wizard.eyebrow: Three steps, your consent at each
wizard.chooseBody: Pick what the person you share with should see (up to {max} items).
wizard.consentItems: I choose these {n} item(s) and nothing else
wizard.consentItemsHint: Nothing you did not tick is shown.
wizard.previewBody: This is exactly what the verifier sees.
wizard.previewNoName: No name, no photo, no employee number.
wizard.label: Label (for you)
wizard.labelHint: For example the application or secondment it is for.
wizard.consentShare: Create a link anyone with it can open until it expires
wizard.consentShareHint: You can revoke it at any time; each view is counted.
wizard.madeBody: It works until {date}. Send it to the person who needs it.

lr.linksBody: Every link you created, with its expiry and how often it was opened.
lr.linksEmptyBody: Create one above when you need to show part of your record.
lr.revokeBody: The link stops showing anything about you straight away.
lr.revokeReason: Reason (optional for you, kept in the audit)

verify.intro: A Kafa'a learner record shared by its holder. Only the items they chose are shown, with their initials.
verify.banner: Kafa'a records are internal recognition. Qualification lines mirror the licensee's systems as qualified or not qualified only; nothing here is a FANR certificate or licence.
verify.error: The record could not be checked
verify.notFoundBody: Check the link with the person who shared it.
verify.closedBody: Nothing about the holder is shown. Ask them for a new link if you still need it.
verify.notice: Signatures are checked in your browser against the published Kafa'a issuer keys.

sg.intro: Pick the skills you want to grow, the level you aim for and by when. The Coach weighs your goals, and they stay private unless you share them with your manager.
sg.privacyBody: Only you see your goals. Share a goal with your manager if you want their help; you can make it private or withdraw it at any time. HR and colleagues never see them.

tile.reachedSub: at or above the target level

sg.unplannedBody: You added these from a skill page. Add a target date to plan them (and to be able to share them).
sg.listBody: Ordered by what needs attention first.
sg.emptyBody: Add one here, from your passport or from any skill page.
sg.coachTitle: How the Coach uses your goals
sg.coachBody: When the Coach ranks pathways and learning, it adds weight to anything that builds a skill on your goals.
sg.coachRole: A gap for a role you are working towards (2030) counts most.
sg.coachGoal: A skill goal counts next: you see "one of your skill goals" in the reasons.
sg.coachWithdraw: Withdraw a goal and the Coach stops weighing it at once.
sg.removedBody: Kept for your history; not shared and not weighed.
sg.shareLabel: Share this goal with my manager
sg.shareHint: Your line manager (and managers above them) can then see it. You can undo this.

problem.restricted: Security skills are not personal goals: they follow the security career path
problem.obsolete: This skill is obsolete: choose its replacement
problem.invalid: Choose a level from 1 to 4 and a date between two weeks and three years from today (note up to 300 characters)

sg.confirmSavePrivate: Level {level} by {date}. Private: only you see it.
sg.confirmSaveShared: Level {level} by {date}. Shared with your manager.
sg.confirmShareBody: Managers whose scope covers you can see this goal, its date and your note.
sg.confirmUnshareBody: Your manager no longer sees this goal.
sg.confirmWithdrawBody: It is unshared straight away and the Coach stops weighing it. You can add it again later.
sg.stripEmptyBody: Pick a skill and a date; the Coach will weigh it.
sg.stripNoneShared: No skill goals shared with you.

team.intro: Goals people in your scope chose to share with you. Private goals are never shown or counted.
team.optInBody: Each person decides which goals you see and can take them back at any time.
team.emptyBody: When someone in your team shares a skill goal, it appears here.
team.note: Use this to support development conversations, not to rate performance.
